A few good alternatives depending on needs:

- **Sensitive teeth:** Sensodyne (especially Pronamel or Repair & Protect)
- **Strong cavity protection:** any ADA-approved fluoride toothpaste, including Crest or Colgate
- **Whitening:** Crest 3D White or Colgate Optic White, though they can increase sensitivity
- **Kids:** a fluoride children’s toothpaste appropriate for their age, using only a rice-grain smear under age 3 and a pea-sized amount from ages 3–6

If you have frequent cavities, gum bleeding, dry mouth, or dental work, your dentist may recommend a specific formula or prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste.

- Excellent extension support, including uBlock Origin
- Good cross-platform syncing
- Helps preserve browser-engine competition on the web

- **Safari** — best choice if you are all-in on Apple devices, especially for battery life.
- **Edge** — solid on Windows, efficient, but more Microsoft integration and prompts than I prefer.

My personal default: **Firefox + uBlock Origin**.
